text:
Maya (AE): Quick request from AtlasGrid procurement: SIG/CAIQ + our incident response + explicit breach notification window. They also asked whether Redwood can temporarily store keys for a 30-day POC and what proof of deletion looks like. Need a buyer-facing one-pager by tomorrow 9am PT.

Ibrahim (Security): I can own the SIG/CAIQ and IR summary. Short answers up front: BYOK is our default for VPC; temporary escrow is available as a paid, auditable add-on with HSM-backed storage, strict access controls, and a deletion certificate at POC end.

Maya (AE): Procurement wants exact language: "If Redwood detects a security incident that affects AtlasGrid data, when will AtlasGrid be notified?" Please include that sentence verbatim in the packet.

Clara (Legal): For notification timelines we provide two contract options: (A) Standard: notify within 72 hours of confirmed data impact; (B) Enterprise SLA: notify within 48 hours conditioned on a negotiated indemnity/forensics cooperation clause. If AtlasGrid requires HIPAA-level timing or regulator-specific timelines, we'll need to map those requirements explicitly.

Jules (Solutions): For the POC: recommend VPC + customer KMS. If they want escrow, propose: HSM-backed escrow vault, access strictly restricted to named PS engineers, full audit trail, and automated destruction with signed deletion certificate. Add PS hours to cover key import/export and verification.

Ibrahim (Security): Operational IR timeline to include in the one-pager (concise):

```
IR highlights:
- Acknowledge detection: within 1 hour (alert triage)
- Interim update: within 24 hours after detection
- Scope & containment: 0-48 hours (depends on complexity)
- Customer notification: within 72 hours of confirmed customer-impacting incident
- Post-incident report: deliverable within 10 business days (interim findings sooner)
- Contacts: security@redwood.ai, ir-oncall@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai, comms@redwood.ai
```

Ibrahim (Security): Note: we can present the 48-hour contracted option, but operationally some incidents require longer for accurate scope; we call this out. Also include that regulatory notifications (e.g., HIPAA) will follow applicable law timelines and we will coordinate with the customer.

Clara (Legal): I'll add two short clause snippets for the packet: a standard 72h clause and a conditional 48h clause that references higher liability cap and customer cooperation on forensics and evidence preservation (chain-of-custody). For key escrow we'll add a deletion-certificate clause: Redwood to provide signed proof of key destruction within 7 days of POC end and allow customer audit of deletion logs.

Maya (AE): AtlasGrid specifically asked about "proof" of deletion and whether forensic logs are accessible. Can we offer read-only log export or a joint forensics window?

Jules (Solutions): We can provide an exported, time-stamped audit log bundle for the POC environment and a 48-hour joint forensics access window post-incident where necessary (requires NDA + PS support). That should satisfy procurement.

Ibrahim (Security): I'll attach SOC2 redacted link and the latest pentest summary. SOC2 redacted: https://files.redwood/security/soc2-redacted-2026.pdf. Pentest: 2026-06-01. Also adding a short note that some CAIQ controls are "Private-only" and listing compensating controls (detailed audit logs, RBAC, PS-access control).

asset-bot: asset-bot: Uploaded docs: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/atlasgrid-sig-caiq-1783100000.pdf, https://files.redwood/sales/poc/atlasgrid-poc-sow-1783100000.pdf

Clara (Legal): I'll draft the clause snippets and deletion-certificate wording tonight and drop into the bundle. Also adding sample indemnity language required for escrow.

Maya (AE): Great. Target: send packet to AtlasGrid procurement by 08:30 PT tomorrow. Ibrahim/Clara/Jules please finalize tonight; I'll review in the AM. Thanks team :pray:
